bbox_convention: Half-open [x,y,x+w,y+h]. Exact artwork crops; labels only in gutters. Minimum gap 48px.
status: Cute redo. Cuteness governs. Earlier geometry is not imported, traced or reused.
prior_sheet_diagnosis: Long profile muzzles, small high eyes and pointed tails made the guardian sheet read as adult diagrams.
Angular surfaces overpowered expression. This redo uses chibi anatomy, soft cheeks, large low eyes and rounded tails.

warm_accent.name: rose
warm_accent.reason: One soft rose hue makes the nose and cheeks feel warm against snow without changing the pale coat.

geometry_notes: Measurements are local construction coordinates, before pose transforms; head height measures the face mass excluding protruding ears.
Sitter total height is approximately twice its face height; crouched, curled and peeking poses compress visible height further.
Body and tail use ellipse blobs; paws have no joints. Tail area exceeds the body area.
Rounded triangles are built by dilating a convex triangle with circular caps. Every vertex receives >=8% radius; no sharp polygon tip is left exposed.
Open eyes always have a solid night ellipse and a 25% upper-left snow catchlight, plus a smaller lower-right catchlight.
Closed eyes in sleeping and happy expressions use curved eyelids instead of an iris; these intentional expression exceptions have no catchlight.
The sleepy expression keeps open oval eyes and both catchlights. All direction faces except Doze have open eyes.
Blush is on all eight directions; the single warm hue is alpha-composited over the opaque cheek, not baked into a rectangular matte.
rendering: Pillow only; 2560px RGBA masters. LANCZOS for every final size. Pose rotations use Pillow BICUBIC at master resolution. No hand-tuned tiny variants.

directions.name: mochi
directions.pose: Front-on sitter, tail wrapped around its feet; steady eye contact and a tiny w smile.
directions.concept: The everyday survivor: comfortable before, during and after the weather changes.
directions.trait: Unbreakable: ordinary comfort is the constant, not a heroic pose.
directions.expression: Open, trusting eyes; warm blush; small w smile.
directions.cute_reason: YES: oversized cheeks, huge sparkling eyes and a tail blanket make it feel like a small companion.
directions.at_16px: A pale big-eared face with two dark eyes; smile and blush disappear. The tail merges into a soft base.

cuteness_review.reason: YES: oversized cheeks, huge sparkling eyes and a tail blanket make it feel like a small companion.

directions.construction_metrics: Shared face measurements in geometry_rules; uniform per-pose scaling preserves these ratios.

directions.name: pillow

directions.concept: At home on the data; relaxed enough to use the store as a pillow.
directions.trait: Durable storage: data is a dependable resting place.
directions.expression: Wide eyes looking up; slightly squashed cheeks and a shy smile.
directions.cute_reason: YES: the chin is low between marshmallow paws; the enormous face does all the emotional work.
directions.at_16px: A wide-eyed pale loaf over a blue baseline. The storage slabs merge; the relaxed face remains.

directions.name: pitter
directions.pose: A tiny walker with one lifted blob paw, a body-sized tail and round prints behind it.
directions.concept: Trail: keep going, leaving a readable trace in the snow.
directions.trait: Runs without support: the small animal keeps moving on its own; prints also carry the Trail record metaphor.
directions.expression: A soft inquisitive gaze, blush and a small smile.
directions.cute_reason: YES: the lifted mitten paw and oversize face give the walk a toddler-like rhythm.
directions.at_16px: A pale face with a tail and one little foot. Prints disappear; the character survives better than the walking story.

expressions.only_changes: Eyelid/eye shape and mouth; catchlights remain on every open eye.

reasons.mochi: Strongest single companion: eye contact, round face and tail blanket; versatile expression system.
reasons.chime: Most affectionate interaction; a natural Chirps character story.
reasons.pillow: Chin on paws gives the clearest cozy database scene.
reasons.peek: A simple face-and-paws sticker that remains inviting at small scales.
reasons.doze: Cozy sleeping bundle; expression is deliberately quiet and weak at 16px.
reasons.tumble: Playful and energetic; pose needs thumbnail space to read.
reasons.pitter: Sweet lifted-paw walk, but the Trail prints need more pixels.
reasons.flurry: The base character is cute; wind adds noise. Shortlisted for the survival message rather than novelty.

recommendation.tiny_icon_limit: Doze, Tumble and Chime lose their stories at 16px; none is approved as a final favicon.
